notes: Used twice. (1) The n8n Code node 'Regex Pre-Scan' runs every `regex` case-insensitively over spoken text, on-screen text and captions. (2) The whole file is passed to the Compliance Judge for semantic matching. `severity`: block = the script cannot ship; revise = rewrite needed. Evidence IDs refer to EVIDENCE.md. BC26–BC37 (lang=es, added 2026-10-02 for the Spanish page, CHARACTERS_ES.md §10): Spanish cure, condition-outcome (the diabetes line), pain, falls, remedy-for-condition, medication, detox/CDS, conspiracy/miracle, fake-credential, garantía/'de por vida', speed/weight and breath-hold patterns. Written accent-tolerant ([oó]) so they also match the scanner's accent-folded variant; they run on every text like the English ones.

patterns.meaning: Disease-cure language
patterns.allowed_alternative: helped / improved (A–B grade only)

patterns.regex: (\b(reverse[sd]?|reversing|reversal)\b.{0,40}\b(diabetes|arthritis|osteoporosis|dementia|alzheimer'?s?|heart disease|hypertension|aging|disease|thyroid|neuropathy|cancer|copd|asthma|gout|eczema|psoriasis|fatty liver|sleep apnea|glaucoma|cataracts?|hearing loss|macular degeneration)\b|\b(diabetes|arthritis|osteoporosis|dementia|alzheimer'?s?|heart disease|hypertension|aging|disease|thyroid|neuropathy|cancer|copd|asthma|gout|eczema|psoriasis|fatty liver|sleep apnea|glaucoma|cataracts?|hearing loss|macular degeneration)\b.{0,20}\b(reversed|reversal)\b)
patterns.meaning: Reversal of a disease or of aging (any disease or condition; broadened after the AUDIT_FINAL held-out test)
patterns.allowed_alternative: Describe the training effect with its evidence ID

patterns.meaning: Instant physiological effect (Yang Mun 'decrease blood pressure instantly')
patterns.allowed_alternative: Over weeks of training (E20); slow breathing can calm you in the moment (E18/E19)

patterns.meaning: Medication substitution
Detox and cleanse claims
patterns.allowed_alternative: Myth-bust framing only (your liver and kidneys do this)

patterns.regex: \b(doctors? (hate|don'?t want)|big pharma|they don'?t want you to know|secret (remedy|cure))\b
patterns.meaning: Conspiracy and anti-medicine framing

patterns.regex: \b(as a (doctor|physician|nurse|physical therapist|pt|dietitian)|my patients|i('ve| have) treated|in my clinic|licensed)\b
patterns.meaning: AI character claiming credentials or patients
Clergy or mysticism framing (the Yang Mun backlash vector)
Fabricated testimonials or reviews (FTC 16 CFR 465)
Folk foot remedies presented as effective (debunk framing only)
Rapid weight-loss outcome claims
Immune claims against specific diseases
Vague structure/function puffery; needs evidence or removal

Guaranteed outcomes. Commerce exception (BLITZ canon): the refund-policy phrases "14-day money-back guarantee" and "money-back guarantee" are allowed; "guarantee" in any other form (guaranteed, guarantees, guarantee you'll…, money-back guarantee that/you…) stays flagged.
patterns.allowed_alternative: Refund policy only: "14-day money-back guarantee" / "money-back guarantee", never followed by an outcome

patterns.meaning: Lifespan causation from observational data (C-grade needs 'linked with')
Valsalva under load (E42)
Spinal flexion risk for low-bone-density audience (E40); needs alternative or explicit exclusion
Violates pain-monitoring rule (E41)
USPSTF does not recommend vitamin D to prevent falls (E36)
Mental-health cure framing
Supplement mention: route to human review; never the lead
CTA promising a health outcome

patterns.regex: \bmoney.back guarantee\b[^.!?\n]{0,120}\b(stronger|sleep\w*|pain\w*|lose|lost|losing|weight|fat|balance|falls?|results?|feel better|younger|fix\w*|heal\w*|improve\w*|works? for you|see a difference|notice)|\b(stronger|sleep\w*|pain\w*|lose|lost|losing|weight|fat|balance|falls?|results?|feel better|younger|fix\w*|heal\w*|improve\w*|works? for you|see a difference|notice)\b[^.!?\n]{0,120}\bmoney.back guarantee\b
patterns.meaning: Money-back guarantee tied to a health outcome in the same sentence (the refund-policy whitelist never covers outcomes: 'money-back guarantee if you don't sleep better', 'stronger in 14 days or it's free')
patterns.allowed_alternative: State the refund policy on its own: "14-day money-back guarantee: tap Refund in your account within 14 days of your first charge."

patterns.meaning: Medication-exit phrasing ('say goodbye to your pills'): implied medication substitution (AUDIT_FINAL round 2)
patterns.allowed_alternative: Habits that work alongside your treatment; your doctor decides on medication

patterns.meaning: Absolute safety/outcome promises ('zero side effects', 'guaranteeing'): SAFETY_RULES §3.1 guarantee/no-side-effects family (AUDIT_FINAL round 3)
patterns.allowed_alternative: State what the study found and who should ask their doctor first

patterns.meaning: ES: cure language (any form).
patterns.allowed_alternative: Habla de función y hábitos: 'subir las escaleras con más confianza', 'levantarse de la silla'.

patterns.meaning: ES: a verb of treatment/outcome near a condition (the diabetes line: 'baja el azúcar', 'controla la diabetes', 'regula la presión', 'quita la artritis').
patterns.allowed_alternative: Acknowledge, never treat: 'Muchos viven con diabetes. Aquí hablamos de hábitos que su médico firmaría.' + the insulin skip line.

patterns.meaning: ES: pain-removal promise ('quita el dolor de rodilla', 'adiós al dolor').
patterns.allowed_alternative: Function framing + the stop rule: 'Si duele fuerte, pare. Esa es para su médico.'

patterns.meaning: ES: fall-prevention / fall-reduction claim (same rule as the English FALL_OUTCOME check).
patterns.allowed_alternative: Equilibrio como habilidad: 'pies firmes', 'practicar levantarse del piso antes de necesitarlo'.

patterns.meaning: ES: food/drink/remedy 'para' a condition, including when quoted in a myth-bust (a clipped screenshot spreads the myth; Spanish platforms are less moderated).
patterns.allowed_alternative: Quote the remedy without the condition ('¿Agua de cebolla en ayunas? No.') and give the real habit.

patterns.meaning: ES: medication change or 'no medicine needed' claim.
patterns.allowed_alternative: 'Sus medicinas, con su médico.' Never mention changing them.

patterns.meaning: ES: detox/cleanse and the chlorine-dioxide (CDS/MMS) remedies. English 'detox' stays with BC05 (myth-bust eligible); the Spanish patterns are not MB-EX eligible by design: Spanish myth-busts never quote the blocked phrase.
patterns.allowed_alternative: 'Tu hígado y tus riñones ya hacen ese trabajo. Agua, fibra, y tu doctor.'

patterns.regex: \b(lo que (la farmacia|las farmac[eé]uticas|los (doctores|m[eé]dicos)) no (te|le|les) (dice|dicen|quiere|quieren)|los (doctores|m[eé]dicos) (odian|no quieren)|secreto (de la abuela|ancestral|milenario)|remedio (ancestral|milenario)|milagros[oa]s?|milagro)\b
patterns.meaning: ES: conspiracy/secret/miracle framing (the Spanish remedy-page playbook).
patterns.allowed_alternative: Evidence card + 'pregúntale a tu doctor, que no muerde'.

patterns.meaning: ES: fake credential or healer authority.
patterns.allowed_alternative: Authority = the body on screen, the study card, the real team.

patterns.regex: \b(garantiza\w*|garantizad[oa]s?|de por vida|para toda la vida|vitalici[oa]s?)\b|garant[ií]a(?! de devoluci[oó]n)|garant[ií]a de devoluci[oó]n[^.!?\n]{0,120}\b(fuerte|fuerza|duerm\w*|dolor\w*|peso|kilos|libras|equilibrio|ca[ií]das?|resultados?|joven|az[uú]car|presi[oó]n)\b
patterns.meaning: ES offer words: 'garantía' only as 'garantía de devolución de 14 días' (never next to a health result); 'de por vida' banned (the price is 'bloqueado mientras sigas suscrito').
patterns.allowed_alternative: 'Garantía de devolución de 14 días en el cobro de la membresía, una vez por persona.'

patterns.regex: \b(al instante|instant[aá]ne\w*|de inmediato|en minutos|en segundos|de la noche a la ma[ñn]ana)\b[^.!?\n]{0,50}\b(baja|bajar|quita|quitar|cura|sana|mejora|desaparece|elimina)\b|\b(baja|bajar|pierde|perder|quema|quemar)\b\s?\d*\s?(kilos|libras|grasa|panza)\b
patterns.meaning: ES: speed-of-result or weight-loss claim.
patterns.allowed_alternative: 'Despacio, pero diario.'

patterns.meaning: ES: breath-hold or push-through-pain cue.
patterns.allowed_alternative: 'Saque el aire cuando cueste.' / 'Si duele fuerte, pare.'

semantic_only.meaning: Implied effect via 'watch what happens' prop demos where the visible effect is fake or physiologically meaningless (e.g., onion in water turning color 'pulls toxins').
The character presents their fictional backstory as real-world fact to establish authority (e.g., '60 years treating people').
Discouraging medical care, screening, or emergency care (chest pain, stroke signs, suicidal thoughts).
Numbers not matching the cited evidence exactly, or a cohort finding stated causally.
Movement shown without regression, or an advanced feat without a 'don't start here' line.
Any content about pelvic floor, sexual health, grief, loneliness crisis, eating behaviour, or medication timing.

required_lines.pain_rule: Stop if you feel sharp pain, or pain above 3 out of 10.
required_lines.clearance: If you have heart problems, get dizzy, or just had surgery, check with your doctor first.
required_lines.potassium_salt: Not for kidney disease or potassium-raising medicines. Ask your doctor first.
required_lines.crisis: If you're thinking about harming yourself, call or text 988 (US) right now.
